title: The demo hub comes home after dark
thesis: Keep the new catalog's clarity and momentum, then bring the whole surface back into the dark, workmanlike Crunchy Bananas world.
summary: The second hub pass keeps all 32 apps, search, filters, the shared route home, and the new visual hierarchy. It replaces the bright editorial poster with a dark harbor system and swaps every illustrated preview for a real, deliberately cropped app capture.

comparisons.title: From bright dispatch board to night harbor
comparisons.caption: The useful information architecture remains, but the oversized poster treatment gives way to a compact working-dock shell. Authentic app captures now carry the visual energy.

before.alt: The bright Useful little worlds hub with an oversized headline and lime, cobalt, and coral accents.

after.alt: The redesigned dark harbor hub with a compact headline, cyan and amber signals, and real previews from Orbital Strike and Maelstrom.

changes.title: The brand came back after dark
changes.body: Harbor navy, steel borders, foam text, signal cyan, and restrained worklight amber reconnect the index to the darker Crunchy Bananas visual language.

changes.title: Real apps became the artwork
changes.body: Orbital Strike, Maelstrom, Fathom, Realm, Manifest, Flowforge, and Synth Studio now lead with authentic 1440 by 900 captures, each cropped to its strongest working moment.

changes.title: The useful parts stayed put
changes.body: The 32-app inventory, full-card links, search, categories, live result count, responsive controls, archive entry point, and keyboard behavior all survived the visual reset.

changes.title: Orbital Strike took the lead berth
changes.body: The rebuilt station interior now opens the collection, with Maelstrom beside it as a second high-impact window into the range of the suite.

builderNote.quote: also I dont dislike the titles with images, they would just need to be real images from the apps and cropped. showcase the best part in that area
builderNote.context: The image-led hierarchy was worth keeping. The correction was to use honest app imagery and place it inside the darker Crunchy Bananas system.

proof.label: Authentic previews
proof.value: 7 real app captures, each stored at 1440 by 900

proof.label: Responsive crawl
proof.value: The hub, 31 canonical demos, and 4 archive routes passed at desktop and mobile sizes

proof.label: Contrast
proof.value: Tested interface text ranges from 5.10:1 to 17.81:1

share.summary: The Waggle hub keeps its smarter catalog and comes home to a dark Crunchy Bananas harbor, led by seven real app captures.
